description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing ratings on recipes, including listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting ratings for a mock user. It manages in-memory data structures for ratings and recipes, and provides CRUD operations with route documentation.

methods.name: _find_recipe(recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Finds a recipe in RECIPES by its ID.

methods.name: _recompute_recipe_aggregate(recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Recomputes the average rating and count for a specific recipe based on all user ratings.

methods.name: list_ratings(user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))
methods.description: Lists all ratings for the mock user ID.

methods.name: get_rating(recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user's rating for a recipe, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: upsert_rating( recipe_id: int, payload: RatingUpsertRequest, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"), )
methods.description: Creates or updates a user's rating for a recipe and updates recipe aggregates.

methods.name: delete_rating(recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))
methods.description: Deletes a user's rating for a recipe and updates recipe aggregates.

ctags.name: delete_rating
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_rating(recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id")/
ctags.signature: (recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))

ctags.name: get_rating
ctags.pattern: /^def get_rating(recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id")):$/
ctags.signature: (recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))

ctags.name: list_ratings
ctags.pattern: /^def list_ratings(user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id")):$/

ctags.name: upsert_rating
ctags.signature: ( recipe_id: int, payload: RatingUpsertRequest, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"), )
